questions.questionMarkup: Prying forces are the additional
questions.questionText: Prying forces are the additional

options.html: shearing forces on the bolts because of long joint
options.text: shearing forces on the bolts because of long joint

options.html: bending forces on the bolts because of long joint
options.text: bending forces on the bolts because of long joint

options.html: forces due to friction between the connected parts
options.text: forces due to friction between the connected parts

options.html: tensile forces due to the flexibility of connected parts leading to deformations.
options.text: tensile forces due to the flexibility of connected parts leading to deformations.

questions.explanationHtml:
(d)
Prying forces are additional tensile stresses that develop in bolts when the connected components
are not perfectly rigid and flex under load, causing the bolts to experience increased tension
beyond the initial preload.
